data.long_meaning: Eashwar is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It is a form of Lord Shiva, the supreme deity in Hinduism, representing creation, destruction, and regeneration. Eashwar is the preserver of the universe and is believed to be the god of fertility, prosperity, and auspiciousness.
